runtime.name: Node.js
external_dependencies: Camoufox browser binary (fetched by camofox postinstall)

capabilities.browser_mode: Camofox manages its own virtual display; Playwright headless by default.
capabilities.stealth: Camoufox C++ fingerprint spoofing by default; Playwright stealth plugins on fallback path.
capabilities.proxy: BROWSER_PROXY_* / browser.proxy mapped to Camofox PROXY_* env.
capabilities.challenge: Camofox handles Cloudflare natively; Playwright path keeps wait/click helpers.
capabilities.downloads: Download events stored as artifacts when available.
capabilities.extract_html: extract-html action writes full rendered outerHTML as an html artifact for parsers (e.g. Google Scholar).
